title: Just Juice  Bar Saltfill Spearmint Shortfill 40ml E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Bar Saltfill Spearmint offers a crisp and cooling mint flavour with a subtly sweet finish. This clean, uncomplicated profile captures the essence of fresh Spearmint — smooth on the inhale, cool on the exhale, and ideal for those who prefer a straightforward menthol-style vape with a more mellow edge than traditional Menthol. This 40ml Saltfill is ideal for vapers who enjoy punchy fruit flavours and the versatility of custom nicotine strength. Blended at 60PG/40VG, it’s best suited to MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod systems and starter kits. The Saltfill format leaves space for one or two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to tailor the final strength to your preferences. To make 50ml of 3.3mg e-liquid: Add one 10ml 20mg nicotine shot. To make 60ml of 6.6mg e-liquid: Add two 10ml 20mg nicotine shots. For a nicotine-free option, top up with PG/VG base Mix . The Just Juice Bar Range takes the flavours you love from disposable vapes and transforms them into a more versatile and long-lasting format. Perfect for those who enjoy intense, satisfying fruit flavours. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
